item: Restore merge: a curated-catalogue stamp gives way to another instance's MEASURED verdict, so a measured disqualification no longer lands beside a live qualified (diagnostics rank 14, C52)
status: SHIPPED (reproduced with merge_corpus first; field effect pending the instances' next import)
summary: Field: qualification-integrity.json reported inversions-found on two instances (psx.com.pk, law.go.kr, wiadomosci.onet.pl: live qualified, last judged disqualified), all stamped oo-curated-catalog-1. Reproduced exactly with the real merge_corpus: the adoption UPDATE only fired where the local status was unqualified, and a curated stamp is status qualified, so the incoming measured disqualification landed in the attempt history beside a live qualified. Fix: a local stamp that is the catalogue's default (qualified + oo-curated-catalog-1) is adoptable by an incoming stamp that is not unqualified and not curated, in both directions, the same rule qualification_overlay already applies; the tally (adopted, kept, disagreed) uses the same predicate. A locally measured verdict still wins, and an incoming curated stamp replaces nothing. Five tests; the two core ones fail without the change.
